lastCompletedStory.title: Spine guard test banning inline === 'specified' outside the canonical module

nextStoryContext: US-003 added test/spine/no-inline-specified-predicate.test.ts as a single self-contained spine guard: exports findInlineSpecifiedViolations(files, allowlist=[ALLOWLISTED_FILE]) as the pure scanner (unit-tested with synthetic content, never writing a real violating file into src/), plus a real-tree test that globs 'src/**/*.{ts,tsx}', filters out src/vendor/ (documented rationale: it's an auto-generated build-time embed mirroring templates/commands/cam-plan.md prose, already excluded from typecheck), and asserts zero violations outside src/issues/plannable.ts. Confirmed clean on the current tree (post US-001/US-002): only src/issues/plannable.ts and src/vendor/_generated.ts matched the raw grep, and the guard's allowlist + vendor exclusion account for both. No scripts/check-*.ts entrypoint was added and no check-all.ts GATES wiring was needed -- bun test's default recursive discovery already picks up test/spine/ as part of the two mandatory gates (bun test, and check:all which runs bun test as its first sub-gate). US-004 (docs: mandate backlog derivation via `cam issue list --json` only) is next and is docs-only -- it should point at deriveBacklogJson's JSON shape from US-002 as the canonical machine contract; it does not touch src/issues/ so this guard is unaffected.
